1. (Currently amended) A system (100) for enabling review of a medical image, comprising:
- an image interface (120) for obtaining the medical image (042);
- a user interface subsystem (140) configured to receive user input and to apply one or more graphical elements (310) to the medical image during the review of the medical image, thereby establishing application data representing application of the one or more graphical elements to the medical image, wherein the application data is stored in electronic storage and linked to specific image coordinates or image structures; and
- a reporting subsystem (180) for:
i) accessing a medical database (060) comprising medical information items (062-066) which each represent medical reference information (400-414), wherein the medical information items are indexed and cross-referenced based on predetermined association rules;
ii) retrieving a medical information item (062) from the medical database based on association data, the association data linking the application of the one or more graphical elements, as represented by the application data, to the medical information item through a rule engine that matches the application data to the association data; and
iii) generating a report (182) based on the medical information item, wherein the report includes at least one of: the medical reference information, a codified version thereof, or measurement data derived from the graphical elements.

2. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the medical information item (062) is associated with a codified version of the medical reference information (420), and wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the codified version of the medical reference information in generating the report (182), wherein the codified version is generated by applying a transformation rule or macro to the medical reference information.

3. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 2, wherein:
- the user interface subsystem (140) is arranged for displaying the medical reference information as a selectable graphical element (400-414) to the user, wherein the selectable graphical element is rendered based on the application data; and
- the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the codified version of the medical reference information (420) in generating the report (182) based on the user selecting the selectable graphical element, wherein the selection is recorded as part of the application data.

4. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 2, wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using a macro (080) to generate the codified version of the medical reference information (420) from the medical reference information (400-414), wherein the macro comprises a set of transformation rules stored in the medical database.

5. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 4, wherein the medical information item (062) comprises the macro (080) or a reference to the macro.

6. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 3, wherein the medical information items (062-066) are cross-referenced via hyperlinks stored in the medical database, and wherein the user interface subsystem (140) is arranged for enabling the user to interactively browse to another medical information item by selecting a hyperlink in the selectable graphical element (410-414), wherein the browsing action is recorded in the application data.

7. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 3, wherein the selectable graphical element is a selectable overlay (410, 412) rendered on the medical image, and wherein the user interface subsystem is arranged for displaying the medical reference information in the form of text (410, 412) or graphics (414) in the selectable overlay, wherein the overlay position and content are determined based on the application data.

8. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the one or more graphical elements (310) provide a measurement tool for enabling the user to perform a measurement on the medical image (042) using the user interface subsystem, and wherein the association data is constituted at least in part by measurement data (312) representing the measurement, wherein the measurement data is calculated and stored based on user-defined points or regions on the medical image.

9. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 8, wherein the reporting subsystem (180) is arranged for using the measurement data (312) in generating the report (182).

10. (Currently amended) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the association data is constituted at least in part by a plurality of rules each linking a respective one of the one or more graphical elements (310) to a respective one of the medical information items (062-066), wherein the rules are stored in the medical database and applied by the reporting subsystem to match application data to medical information items.

11. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the application data represents one or more of the group of:
- a type of the one or more graphical elements (310);
- a position of the one or more graphical elements in the medical image; and
- an image structure (044) marked by the one or more graphical elements.

12. (Previously presented) The system (100) according to claim 1, wherein the one or more graphical elements (310) comprise one or more of the group of: a marker, an annotation and a measurement tool (310).

13. (Previously presented) Workstation or imaging apparatus comprising the system according to claim 1.

14. (Currently amended) A method (200) for enabling review of a medical image, comprising:
- obtaining (210) the medical image;
- enabling (220) a user to apply one or more graphical elements to the medical image during the review of the medical image, thereby establishing application data representing application of the one or more graphical elements to the medical image, wherein the application data is stored in electronic storage and includes at least one of: graphical element type, position, or marked image structure;
- accessing (230) a medical database comprising medical information items which each represent medical reference information, wherein the medical information items are indexed and linked via association rules;
- retrieving (240) a medical information item from the medical database based on association data, the association data linking the application of the one or more graphical elements, as represented by the application data, to the medical information item, wherein the retrieval is performed by matching the application data against the association rules; and
- generating (250) a report based on the medical information item, wherein the report includes at least one of: the medical reference information, a codified version thereof, or measurement data derived from the graphical elements.

15. (Currently amended) A __non-transitory__ computer program product (270) comprising instructions for causing a processor system to perform the method according to claim 14.
